title: External local finance JSON workspace v1
description: Host-owned structured financial records, not a StackOS resource or ledger. Validate with format checking. JSON Schema checks structure only; the host checks cross-record IDs/references, evidence custody, additive history, immutable proposal digests, applicable currency precision, arithmetic, approval freshness and exclusive writer ownership.

billing_version.description: Immutable proposal material. Compute digest_sha256 as SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON object containing exactly version, customer_mapping_ref, recipient_settings_ref, external_project_ref when present, currency, terms, lines, subtotal, total, source_refs, and supersedes_ref only when present. Preserve complete nested values and array order. Serialize with sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped Unicode, and no NaN/Infinity (Python: json.dumps(material, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')). Do not normalize strings. Exclude record_id, digest_sha256, metadata, status/history, provenance/gaps, reviews, provider observations, mutation attempts and finance.json revision/hash. Approval separately binds record_id, version and this digest. Mapping and recipient refs identify immutable versions. Immutability, reference integrity and digest correctness require host comparison.

settlement.description: For these digest projections use SHA-256 over the UTF-8 JSON object, preserving complete nested values and array order; sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped Unicode, no string normalization and no NaN/Infinity (Python: json.dumps(material, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')). Include optional named fields only when present, never insert null. Material projection: version, source_ref, source_identity, source_sha256, payment_reference_sha256, provider_ref, account_ref, customer_ref, invoice_ref, received_amount, received_at, selected_route, allocation, match_evidence_refs, duplicate_of_ref, gaps, supersedes_ref. Also include payment_ref only for selected_route=attach-payment, where it is the preexisting selected payment. A payment_ref obtained from report-and-attach is a later execution observation and is excluded. Exclude recovery, decision_refs, review_refs, approval_refs, attempt_refs, write_proof_refs, record_id and common metadata/status/history/provenance. Material scope is immutable per proposal version. Approval separately binds record_id and version; fresh source/provider matching and the exact attachment approval gate remain mandatory.

collection_decision.description: For these digest projections use SHA-256 over the UTF-8 JSON object, preserving complete nested values and array order; sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped Unicode, no string normalization and no NaN/Infinity (Python: json.dumps(material, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')). Include optional named fields only when present, never insert null. Material projection: version, invoice_ref, invoice_observation_ref, eligibility, decision_reason, reminder_owner, due_status, dispute_state, pause_state, promise_state, correction_state, last_contact_at, cooldown_until, recipient_settings_ref, settlement_refs, gaps, supersedes_ref. Exclude send_outcome, attempt_ref, next_eligible_at, review_refs, approval_refs, record_id and common metadata/status/history/provenance. Approval separately binds record_id and version. Fresh lifecycle, recipient and suppression checks remain mandatory before sending; a matching digest is not permission to send.

review.description: target_digest_sha256 binds the exact reviewed material scope. Host resolution must require and match target_version when the target has a version. For an unversioned target, omit target_version and bind its record_id plus a digest of the full target record except created_at, updated_at, status, status_history, review_refs, write_proof_refs and handoff_refs. Include record_id, provenance, gaps and all other business fields. Use the same canonical UTF-8 JSON SHA-256 serialization defined for billing_version. Excluded status and review/write/handoff links are outcomes, not proof; fresh integrity checks remain mandatory. JSON Schema alone cannot validate the resolved target or digest.

tax_packet.description: For these digest projections use SHA-256 over the UTF-8 JSON object, preserving complete nested values and array order; sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped Unicode, no string normalization and no NaN/Infinity (Python: json.dumps(material, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')). Include optional named fields only when present, never insert null. Material projection: version, tax_year, as_of, profile_refs, annual_inputs, source_refs, obligations, gaps, supersedes_ref. Exclude review_state, review_refs, write_proof_refs, handoff_refs, record_id and common metadata/status/history/provenance. Approval separately binds record_id and version. Changed inputs, obligations or gaps require a new proposal version and review.

handoff.description: Host resolution must require and match source_version when the source target has a version. For an unversioned source, omit source_version and require source_digest_sha256 to bind the source record_id and the full target record except created_at, updated_at, status, status_history, review_refs, write_proof_refs and handoff_refs. Include record_id, provenance, gaps and all other business fields. Use the same canonical UTF-8 JSON SHA-256 serialization defined for billing_version. Excluded status and review/write/handoff links are outcomes, not proof; fresh integrity checks remain mandatory. JSON Schema alone cannot validate cross-record versions or digest equality.

write_proof.description: A proof of a prior verified write may be added in a later revision. Never assert this same write was reread before it happened; retain the immediate result outside the pre-write candidate. Do not embed the current whole-file hash.
